title: Integrating Navigation-Assisted Ablation in the Locoregional Treatment of Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), ablative therapy is a critical treatment option to achieve a cancer-free state. The anatomic location of the tumor can be a challenge, and select hepatic locations of a tumor require laparoscopic-assisted strategies to safely reach and treat the lesion.
